read.title: Handover Notes: Key Accounts
read.text:
Hi Jiwon,

As you know, I'll be on leave from December 1 to December 19, and you'll be covering my accounts while I'm away. Here is a quick summary.

First, the Lopez Trading order of 3,000 sheet masks is pending final payment. Once the payment arrives, please ask the warehouse to ship it within two days.

Second, Green Leaf Cosmetics is waiting for a revised quotation. The draft is saved in the shared folder under "Quotes 2026." Please check the prices with Mr. Han before you send it.

I've already told both clients that you will be their point of contact during my absence. I'll check email once a week, but please call me only for urgent issues.

Thanks so much,
Minsu

write.en: Write a short handover email to a coworker who will cover your work during your business trip next week.
write.model:
Hi Sora,

Thanks for covering for me while I'm on my business trip next week. The only pending task is the monthly sales report, which is due on Thursday. All the data is in the shared folder. Ms. Choi from the agency is the point of contact for the banner project. Don't hesitate to contact me if anything comes up.

Best,
Minsu
